report.explanation: Gateway telemetry is largely healthy: error_rate 0.0014, p95 74ms, no dependency timeouts or pool waiters, INFO 200 logs. A single trace shows a 2015ms ERROR span on gateway->inventory, but inventory is not a direct gateway dependency (gateway->order->inventory), and no inventory/order telemetry was admitted. Insufficient evidence to bound a root cause; handoff with missing reads.
missing_evidence: Traces/metrics/logs for order and inventory services over the same window to confirm or refute downstream latency
Inventory and redis latency/timeout metrics to test redis-timeout or downstream-latency causes
Order->postgresql pool metrics to test db-pool-exhaustion
Error-rate and latency time series for gateway to confirm alert alignment and duration
Logs/errors from the failing gateway->inventory span to identify the error type
